theorems.name: Submission.rpn_pfd_wedge_cons_succAbove_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (l : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (j : Fin (m + 1)), wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons (l j) (fun k => l (j.succAbove k)) : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) l ∧ ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), i ≠ j → wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons (l i) (fun k => l (j.succAbove k)) : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) = 0
